Hugo Ramirez  
Bengaluru, India | +91 98765 43210 | hugo.ramirez@email.com  

A seasoned backend engineer with nine years of experience shaping scalable, high-availability systems within the SaaS sector. Specialized in architecting microservices, optimizing distributed databases, and deploying cloud-native solutions. Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, mentor junior engineers, and deliver reliable infrastructure under demanding operational constraints.  

Senior Backend Engineer  
NexaCorp (2021–present)  
Led the migration of monolithic systems to a microservices architecture, reducing deployment cycles by 40% and improving system resilience. Designed and implemented REST APIs that powered critical customer-facing tools, achieving 99.95% uptime. Spearheaded the adoption of Go for performance-critical components, resulting in a 30% reduction in latency. Collaborated with DevOps teams to refine CI/CD pipelines, ensuring rapid iteration without compromising security or compliance.  

Tech Lead  
CloudSolutions (2019–2021)  
Architected a PostgreSQL-based data pipeline that processed 10M+ transactions daily, optimizing query performance through indexing and sharding strategies. Mentored a team of six engineers in best practices for asynchronous communication and error handling in distributed systems. Spearheaded the integration of Docker containers for consistent environments, reducing environment-specific bugs by 25%.  

Senior Backend Engineer  
ScaleTech (2016–2019)  
Designed and maintained a high-throughput API layer for a B2B SaaS platform, handling 500K+ requests per second. Instrumental in transitioning the company’s infrastructure to AWS, where I optimized costs by 15% through automated scaling and resource tagging. Developed Python scripts to automate monitoring tasks, reducing manual overhead for operations teams.  

Backend Developer  
StartUp Inc. (2014–2016)  
Built foundational backend services for a cloud storage platform, focusing on robustness and scalability. Contributed to the implementation of a custom logging system that improved troubleshooting efficiency by 35%.  

Technical Skills  
- **AWS**: Designed and maintained cloud infrastructure for three SaaS products, mentoring junior engineers in best practices for cost optimization and security.  
- **Go**: Engineered core components of high-performance systems, including rate-limiting middleware and distributed task queues.  
- **Microservices Architecture**: Led the decomposition of monolithic applications into modular services, reducing mean time to recovery by 20%.  
- **PostgreSQL**: Optimized complex queries and database schemas, achieving sub-second response times for critical operations.  
- **REST API Design**: Defined standardized endpoints for internal and external integrations, ensuring consistency across 12+ services.  
- **Python**: Developed automation scripts and data processing pipelines, reducing manual effort in operations and analytics workflows.  
- **Docker**: Containerized critical services to ensure environment parity, streamlining deployment and testing processes.  
- **CI/CD Pipelines**: Integrated automated testing and deployment flows, enabling nightly builds with 98% success rate.  
- **Linux Administration**: Occasionally managed server configurations for staging environments, ensuring compliance with security policies.
